# Discussion

The discussion will first interpret regeneration responses in relation to the
silvicultural objective of developing a new redwood cohort beneath varying
levels of retained overstory. It will then interpret phase-specific fuel
conditions and the PCT-associated contrast as a linked management question,
with conclusions limited to the reviewed sampling design and analysis.

This structure treats silviculture and fire management as linked management
questions while keeping conclusions within the support of the reviewed analyses
and cited literature.
